trial_title: BI 10773 (Empagliflozin) Cardiovascular Outcome Event Trial in Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus Patients (EMPA-REG OUTCOME).

patient.summary: 3 years old at screening, recorded sex female

approximations: the protocol anchors this window to consent, which was evaluated against the screening date

absence_policy.note: coverage-gated, meaning a finding absent from the chart counts as absent only where an encounter documents the window

criteria.quote: Diagnosis of type 2 diabetes mellitus prior to informed consent
criteria.rationale: type 2 diabetes mellitus is not documented in a window the chart covers
approximations: the protocol anchors this window to consent, which was evaluated against the screening date

criteria.quote: Male or female patients on diet and exercise regimen who are drug naive or pre treated with any background therapy. Antidiabetic therapy has to be unchanged for 12 weeks prior to randomization.
criteria.rationale: this criterion was not formalised because it cannot be decided from data

resolution.missing: human judgement: the chart records prescriptions, not whether antidiabetic therapy was unchanged over the 12 weeks before randomisation

criteria.quote: Glycosylated haemoglobin (HbA1c) of >= 7.0% and <=10% for patients on background therapy or HbA1c >= 7.0% and <= 9.0% for drug naive patients
criteria.rationale: this criterion was not formalised because it cannot be decided from data

resolution.missing: human judgement: back-translation: the compiled predicate is broader than the protocol quote. B admits a drug-naive patient whose HbA1c is between 9.0% and 10%, whom A excludes.

criteria.quote: Age >= 18 years
criteria.rationale: age 3 years at screening against >= 18.0

criteria.quote: Body Mass index <= 45 at Visit 1
Signed and dated informed consent
criteria.rationale: this criterion was not formalised because it cannot be decided from data

resolution.missing: human judgement: consent is a site procedure and leaves no finding in the patient record

criteria.quote: High cardiovascular risk
criteria.rationale: this criterion was not formalised because it cannot be decided from data

resolution.missing: human judgement: the protocol defines high cardiovascular risk in a table the registry record does not carry

criteria.quote: Uncontrolled hyperglycaemia with a glucose level >240 mg/dl (>13.3 mmol/L) after an overnight fast during placebo run-in and confirmed by a second measurement (not on the same day)
criteria.rationale: this criterion was not formalised because it cannot be decided from data

resolution.missing: human judgement: back-translation: the compiled predicate is broader than the protocol quote. A requires a fasting measurement confirmed on a second day; B is satisfied by one random glucose.

criteria.quote: Indication of liver disease, defined by serum levels of either alanine aminotransferase (ALT), aspartate aminotransferase ALT or alkaline phosphatase above 3 x upper limit of normal (ULN) as determined at screening and/or run in.
criteria.rationale: this criterion was not formalised because it cannot be decided from data

resolution.missing: human judgement: back-translation: the compiled predicate is narrower than the protocol quote. A is also triggered by aspartate aminotransferase or alkaline phosphatase above three times the upper limit of normal; B tests only alanine aminotransferase.

criteria.quote: Planned cardiac surgery or angioplasty within 3 months
criteria.rationale: this criterion was not formalised because it cannot be decided from data

resolution.missing: human judgement: a planned procedure is an intention, and the chart records events

criteria.quote: Impaired renal function, defined as Glomerular Filtration Rate <30 ml/min (severe renal impairment, Modification of Diet in Renal Disease formula) during screening or run in.
criteria.rationale: no glomerular filtration rate result is on file for the required window

resolution.where_to_look: the laboratory result system or the most recent panel in the chart

criteria.quote: Bariatric surgery within the past two years and other gastrointestinal surgeries that induce chronic malabsorption
criteria.rationale: this criterion was not formalised because it cannot be decided from data

resolution.missing: human judgement: 'other gastrointestinal surgeries that induce chronic malabsorption' names no enumerable set of procedure codes

criteria.quote: Blood dyscrasias or any disorders causing haemolysis or unstable Red Blood Cell (e.g. malaria, babesiosis, haemolytic anemia)
criteria.rationale: this criterion was not formalised because it cannot be decided from data

resolution.missing: human judgement: the criterion names three examples of an open class of disorders, and compiling the examples would exclude fewer patients than the protocol does

criteria.quote: Medical history of cancer (except for basal cell carcinoma) and/or treatment for cancer within the last 5 years
criteria.rationale: malignant neoplastic disease is not documented in a window the chart covers

criteria.quote: Contraindications to background therapy according to the local label
criteria.rationale: this criterion was not formalised because it cannot be decided from data

resolution.missing: human judgement: the local label is not part of the patient record

criteria.quote: Treatment with anti-obesity drugs (e.g. sibutramine, orlistat) 3 months prior to informed consent or any other treatment at the time of screening (i.e. surgery, aggressive diet regimen, etc.) leading to unstable body weight
criteria.rationale: this criterion was not formalised because it cannot be decided from data

resolution.missing: human judgement: the second half of the criterion covers any treatment leading to unstable body weight, which names no coded intervention

criteria.quote: Current treatment with systemic steroids at time of informed consent or change in dosage of thyroid hormones within 6 weeks prior to informed consent or any other uncontrolled endocrine disorder except type 2 diabetes mellitus
criteria.rationale: this criterion was not formalised because it cannot be decided from data

resolution.missing: human judgement: a change in thyroid dose and an uncontrolled endocrine disorder are neither of them recorded as a codeable finding

criteria.quote: Pre-menopausal women (last menstruation <+ 1 year prior to informed consent) who:
criteria.rationale: this criterion was not formalised because it cannot be decided from data

resolution.missing: human judgement: birth control and agreement to periodic pregnancy testing are undertakings by the patient, not findings in the chart

criteria.quote: Alcohol or drug abuse within the 3 months prior to informed consent that would interfere with trial participation or any ongoing condition leading to a decreased compliance to study procedures or study drug intake
criteria.rationale: this criterion was not formalised because it cannot be decided from data

resolution.missing: human judgement: the criterion turns on whether the behaviour would interfere with participation, which is a judgement rather than a finding

criteria.quote: Participation in another trial with an investigational drug within 30 days prior to informed consent
criteria.rationale: this criterion was not formalised because it cannot be decided from data

resolution.missing: human judgement: participation in another trial is not recorded in the chart

criteria.quote: Any other clinical condition that would jeopardize patients safety while participating in this clinical trial
criteria.rationale: this criterion was not formalised because it cannot be decided from data

resolution.missing: human judgement: the criterion is a catch-all reserved for the investigator

criteria.quote: Acute coronary syndrome, stroke or TIA within 2 months prior to informed consent
criteria.rationale: acute coronary syndrome is not documented in a window the chart covers or stroke is not documented in a window the chart covers or transient ischaemic attack is not documented in a window the chart covers
